steps.title: Optional in silico Golden Gate assembly
steps.instruction: Generate Benchling maps of all plasmids and verify assemblies before wet‑lab work using the Benchling Golden Gate Assembly wizard.

substeps.instruction: Create a new Benchling project and import all source DNA sequences (plasmids, oligos).
For each sgRNA forward oligo, prepend CGTCTCA and append GTTTTGAGACG (BsmBI sites), then save the extended sequence.
Open the first plasmid, start a new Golden Gate assembly, select BsaI or BsmBI as the Type IIS enzyme, and add backbone and insert fragments in the correct order.
Repeat for all fragments; Benchling will check compatible overhangs.
Click “Assemble”, choose a folder for the new plasmid, and export the assembled sequences as GenBank files.
If many assemblies share parts, reuse the assembly file via “Assembly → Re‑open” and swap only the changed fragments.

steps.title: Prepare E. coli competent cells
steps.instruction: Make DH5α chemically competent cells by either the Inoue or calcium‑chloride method and freeze aliquots at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Follow the Inoue protocol (higher efficiency) or the CaCl₂ protocol (simpler) as described in Green and Sambrook 2020 or Sambrook and Russell 2006.
Aliquot cells and store at –80 °C for later use.

steps.title: Plasmid preparation
steps.instruction: Grow overnight cultures of all required yeast‑toolkit plasmids, isolate DNA, measure concentration, and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate each plasmid (pYTK050, pYTK003, pYTK068, pYTK095, pYTK‑DN1, pYTK‑DN2, pYTK‑DN4, pYTK‑DN5, pYTK‑DN6, and if needed pYTK004, pYTK072, pYTK‑DN3) in 2 mL LB with the appropriate antibiotic; incubate 12–20 h at 37 °C.
Harvest cells and perform a miniprep using the kit’s instructions.
Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.
Store purified plasmids at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare plates and media
steps.instruction: Make LB agar plates with three antibiotics, corresponding liquid media, and YPD media for yeast, adding selection drugs as needed.

substeps.instruction: Prepare LB‑chloramphenicol agar (25 µg/mL Cm) and LB‑chloramphenicol liquid (25 µg/mL).
Prepare LB‑ampicillin agar (100 µg/mL Amp) and LB‑ampicillin liquid (100 µg/mL).
Prepare LB‑kanamycin agar (50 µg/mL Kan) and LB‑kanamycin liquid (50 µg/mL).
Prepare YPD liquid medium (standard recipe).
Prepare YPD‑agar plates containing the drug matching the resistance marker of the final plasmid:
• G418 200 µg/mL for KanR (pYTK‑DN4),
• clonNAT 100 µg/mL for NatR (pYTK‑DN5),
• hygromycin B 200 µg/mL for HygR (pYTK‑DN6).

steps.title: First Golden Gate assembly (GG1)
steps.instruction: Clone the sgRNA oligos into the pYTK050 dropout vector to generate the sgRNA part plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the ds‑sgRNA fragment 1:500 (from step 3).

Set up a 10 µL GG1 reaction: 0.4 µL ds‑sgRNA (1:500), 0.4 µL pYTK050 (≈20 fmol, calculate with the provided Excel sheet), 1 µL 10× T4 buffer, 1 µL T7 ligase, 0.5 µL BsmBI, 0.5 µL ddH₂O, and add water to 10 µL total.
Run the thermocycler: 25 cycles of 42 °C 2 min (digestion) followed by 16 °C 5 min (ligation), then 60 °C 10 min, 80 °C 10 min, hold at 4 °C.

Transform 3 µL of the reaction into 25 µL Inoue‑competent cells (or 5 µL into 50 µL CaCl₂‑competent cells): thaw on ice, add DNA, mix gently, incubate on ice 30 min, heat‑shock 42 °C 30 s, ice 2 min, add 950 µL LB (20‑25 °C), shake 37 °C 60 min at 250 rpm, plate 100 µL on LB‑chloramphenicol agar, incubate 12–20 h at 37 °C.
Select white colonies (loss of GFP) and inoculate 1–2 colonies in 3 mL LB‑chloramphenicol; grow overnight 12–20 h at 37 °C.
Mini‑prep plasmid, measure concentration, keep 1 mL for glycerol stock (optional).
Optional verification: digest 400 ng DNA with 2 µL PvuII‑HF in 10× CutSmart buffer, 0.4 µL ddH₂O to 20 µL total, 15 min at 37 °C; load 20 µL on agarose gel with 4 µL 6× loading dye.

steps.title: Second Golden Gate assembly (GG2)
steps.instruction: Assemble the sgRNA part into a transcriptional unit (TU2 or TU3) to create the sgRNA cassette plasmid.

substeps.instruction: For a TU2 cassette, combine in a 10 µL reaction: 20 fmol pYTK003 (ConL1), 20 fmol sgRNA part plasmid, 20 fmol pYTK068 (ConR2), 20 fmol pYTK095 (AmpR‑ColE1), 1 µL 10× T4 buffer, 1 µL T7 ligase, 0.5 µL BsaI, 0.5 µL ddH₂O.

For a TU3 cassette, combine: 20 fmol pYTK004 (ConL2), 20 fmol sgRNA part plasmid, 20 fmol pYTK072 (ConRE), 20 fmol pYTK095, 1 µL 10× T4 buffer, 1 µL T7 ligase, 0.5 µL BsaI, 0.5 µL ddH₂O (total 10 µL).
Run the same thermocycler program as GG1.
Transform 3 µL of the assembly into 25 µL Inoue‑competent cells (or 5 µL into 50 µL CaCl₂ cells) as in step 5, then plate 100 µL on LB‑ampicillin agar and incubate 12–20 h at 37 °C.
Pick white colonies, inoculate 3 mL LB‑ampicillin, grow overnight 12–20 h at 37 °C, miniprep, measure DNA, keep 1 mL for glycerol stock (optional).
Optional verification: digest ~400 ng DNA with 2 µL XbaI in 10× CutSmart buffer, 0.4 µL ddH₂O to 20 µL, 15 min at 37 °C; run on agarose gel.

steps.title: Third Golden Gate assembly (GG3)
steps.instruction: Combine Cas9 cassette with one or two sgRNA cassettes and a spacer (if needed) into the yeast expression vector to generate the multi‑gene plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Choose the appropriate mix:

• For Cas9 + sgRNA1 (TU2): 20 fmol pYTK‑DN1 (Cas9), 20 fmol sgRNA1 cassette, 20 fmol pYTK‑DN2 (spacer), 20 fmol yeast vector (pYTK‑DN4, ‑DN5 or ‑DN6), 1 µL 10× T4 buffer, 1 µL T7 ligase, 0.5 µL BsmBI, 0.5 µL ddH₂O (10 µL total).
• For Cas9 + sgRNA2 (TU3): replace pYTK‑DN2 with pYTK‑DN3 (spacer) and sgRNA1 cassette with sgRNA2 cassette.
• For Cas9 + sgRNA1 + sgRNA2: include both sgRNA1 and sgRNA2 cassettes (no spacer plasmid).
Run the same thermocycler program as GG1.
Transform 3 µL of the assembly into 25 µL Inoue‑competent cells (or 5 µL into 50 µL CaCl₂ cells), add 950 µL LB, recover 60 min at 37 °C, plate 100 µL on LB‑kanamycin agar, incubate 12–20 h at 37 °C.
Select white colonies, inoculate 3 mL LB‑kanamycin, grow overnight 12–20 h at 37 °C, miniprep, measure concentration, keep 1 mL for glycerol stock (optional).

Verify correct assembly by EcoRI‑HF digestion: 400 ng DNA + 2 µL EcoRI‑HF + 2 µL 10× CutSmart + 0.4 µL ddH₂O to 20 µL; incubate 15 min at 37 °C, add 4 µL 6× loading dye, run 20 µL on agarose gel (expected 5.4 kb + 3.8 kb for single‑sgRNA plasmids, 3 fragments for dual‑sgRNA).
Optional: confirm sgRNA insert by Sanger sequencing with primer sgRNA‑seq‑fwd.
